name: Lat Pulldown
steps: Sit with thighs held under the pad and grip the overhead bar wider than shoulder width.
Keep the chest tall with a small backward lean.
Pull the bar toward the upper chest by driving elbows down.
Let the arms extend overhead under control.
cues: Pull in front of the head.
mistakes: Rocking backward or yanking the stack.
breathing: Exhale while pulling down; inhale on the return.
